findings: Fabrication is rare (1.06%) and concentrated in cross-context borrowing — content true elsewhere in the package (or in reality) grafted onto the wrong unit. This is the failure class the per-unit source-locator discipline exists to catch.

Recurring compile error (both repair rounds): a 'choose-X-vs-alternatives' reference unit emitted without steps/reference pointer. Prompt fix: tell the compiler reference units must carry their facts AS steps.
delivery.stages was flagged synthesized on ~100% of units — honest (the packages never state stages) but noisy; consider exempting stages from the flag or accepting the noise.
4 units have imprecise source locators (audit: 'do not plausibly resolve') — anchor-precision needs a compiler-prompt nudge, though claims themselves were supported.
Compiler units track the E0 reference decomposition closely (peft: 7 vs 5 units, same core operations plus a diagnose unit and method-selection split) — no systematic representation drift.
The compiled peft QLoRA unit independently generated the inverted-conditional avoid_when (the mvp-029 RCA fix) and flagged it synthesized.
pending: Upstream spot-check (~20 numeric claims vs upstream docs) — automated via web fetch; quantifies corpus trustworthiness as a limitation. Not a gate.
Behavioral analogs (linking eval on NodeProfile fixtures + functional A/B via eval_core) — depend on the W5 linker; folded into W5/W6.
run_gate wiring: fold compile+grounding metrics into the builder ship-gate consumption path (currently standalone reports under evals/).
